newsitem.title: LATVIA: OLAINFARM NEXT WEEK ON BOURSE SECONDARY LIST.
newsitem.headline: OLAINFARM NEXT WEEK ON BOURSE SECONDARY LIST.

text.p: The Riga stock exchange on Friday said the Olainfarm pharmaceutical company will start trading on the bourse's secondary list next week.
A total 26 percent of the company's shares were sold by public offer and the auction determined the price of its share at 1.54 lats.
"Next week Olainfarm will be on the bourse..most probably on the secondary list," Uldis Cerps, the bourse president, told a news conference.
"It means the bourse capitalisation will increase by some three million lats," Cerps added.
Olainfarm, one of the biggest Latvian pharmaceutical companies, had a balance sheet total of 11.55 million lats and 51 percent of its three million shares is held by Vita Ltd.
Some 26 percent or 804,900 hares of the Olainfarm stock was sold in a public offer.
